messages.subject: Project Polaris - outstanding DD enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Amelia,

Thanks for opening the data room. A few outstanding items from our legal DD questionnaire:

1. Leeds (Calder Wharf) - status of the licence to alter for the 2023 studio fit-out?
2. Pennine Asset Finance - copy of the equipment finance agreement and confirmation of any change-of-control provision.
3. EMI options - exercise notices and updated register of members.
4. The March 2025 York improvement notice - evidence of close-out.

Grateful for these into the data room when you can.

Best,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
